name: AI Regulatory and Compliance Exposure: An Executive Briefing
description: An executive briefing on AI regulatory exposure: supply-chain roles, building an exposure map from your AI inventory, the EU AI Act after the 2026 Digital Omnibus, GPAI obligations, US federal, state and sector rules, other major jurisdictions, standards, liability, and how to prioritize and report a compliance program.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI Regulatory and Compliance Exposure: An Executive Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 15 lessons in 5 modules; and pass the final exam: 15 questions, 30 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
